name: ORMS
detailed_description:
A soul-searching adventure through fear and courage, light and shadow

Step into the hauntingly beautiful world of ORMS, a story-rich atmospheric puzzle adventure where you switch between two realities to solve challenges and rediscover hope. Crafted with heart, ORMS takes players on a surreal journey inspired by classics like Machinarium, Little Nightmares II, and Inside.

About the Game

You play as Sam, a lost boy navigating a world shaped by his deepest fears. Guided by Kira, a fearless girl, you'll explore handcrafted Nordic landscapes and uncover the mysteries surrounding a forgotten lighthouse. Together, their dual perspectives hold the key to shifting between two realities- darkness and light.

  • Switch between characters to experience the world from two perspectives

  • Solve layered puzzles using a unique "Dualism" mechanic

  • Unfold a surreal, atmospheric story about memory, fear, and the bonds that shape us

  • Explore a meticulously crafted world inspired by Nordic folklore, Estonian nature, and emotional storytelling

Why Wishlist ORMS?

ORMS is a passion project created by industry veterans whose experience spans acclaimed titles like Alan Wake and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, as well as a widely used platform like Ready Player Me. United by a common vision, we're driven to make the world better through meaningful games.

short_description: Orms follows Sam, a boy lost in a surreal world shaped by his fears. Guided by Kira, he must restore a lighthouse to reconnect with his parents. The game is inspired by Machinarium, but crafted in 3D with expanded locations. It blends emotional storytelling with atmospheric exploration.
